title: Yellowed Smoky British Cod Fish And Chips
description: A smoky and comforting British dish featuring cod fish, medjool dates, and crispy chips, suitable for a sugar-free diet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.
In a bowl, mix together smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Add the cod fish fillets to the bowl and coat with the spice mixture.
Place the cod fish fillets on the prepared baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake the cod fish fillets in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, heat olive oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Add the potato chips to the hot oil and fry until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the potato chips from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the cod fish fillets with the crispy potato chips and a side of medjool dates.
